sub.zh: 大卫与歌利亚 · 撒母耳记上 17 章

text.en: “You came.” He closes the scroll and tucks it into his sleeve. “The valley is just up this road. That voice has been shouting morning and evening for forty days.”
text.zh: 「你来了。」他把书卷合上，收进袖子里，「山谷就在这条路上去。那声音早晚各喊一次，已经喊了四十天。」

text.en: “You have no armour and no sword. What you have is a hand and a mouth.” He taps your chest. “When the moment comes, those are the only two things that will answer for you.”
text.zh: 「你没有铠甲，也没有刀。你只有一只手和一张嘴。」他指了指你的手，又指了指你的嘴，「到那一刻，能替你答话的就这两样。」

text.en: “Keep this one. You will need it at the top of the road.”
text.zh: 「这一句你收好。走到路的尽头，你会用得上。」

text.en: “Talk to the others before you go up. A man who goes up alone goes up with only his own voice.”
text.zh: 「上去以前，先和另外几个人说话。一个人上去，身上就只剩自己那一句话。」

text.en: He is holding his spear with both hands. “They say he is three metres tall. I cannot tell. I have never been close enough to look.”
text.zh: 他两只手抱着矛。「他们说他有三米高。我看不清——我从来没走近过。」

text.en: “My mother said, do not be afraid, when I left. Then she cried anyway.” He looks at you. “I keep thinking about that. She was afraid too, and she still said it.”
text.zh: 「我出门那天，我妈说不要怕。说完，她还是哭了。」他看着你，「这件事我一直想着。她自己也在怕，可她还是说了。」

text.en: “Take it with you. Somebody said it to a whole nation once, standing at the water. It is not mine to keep.”
text.zh: 「带着走吧。从前有人站在水边，对着一整个国家说过这句话。它不是我的。」

text.en: “If you are going up, go up. I will be here when you come back down.”
text.zh: 「你要上去，就上去。你下来的时候，我还在这儿。」

text.en: She is dividing bread and does not look up. “You are going up too, then. My husband went up. He has not come back down.”
text.zh: 她低着头分饼，没有抬眼。「你也要上去。我男人上去了，还没下来。」

text.en: “I do not pray that he wins,” she says. “I pray that he does not lose himself up there.”
text.zh: 「我不祷告他打赢。」她说，「我祷告他别把自己丢在上面。」

text.en: “Here. Bread, and a psalm. The bread will not last the road. The psalm might.”
text.zh: 「拿着。饼，还有一句诗。饼撑不了多久，这句话也许能陪你走远些。」

text.en: “Eat something before you go. Nobody fights well hungry.”
text.zh: 「上去以前吃点东西。饿着肚子的人打不好仗。」

text.en: An old man is sitting on a stone by the road, mending a strap. “They will not let you through, you know. The king himself has said it: you are too young, and he has been a fighting man since he was a boy.”
text.zh: 一个老人坐在路边的石头上修皮带。「他们不会让你过去的。连王都这么说：你年纪太轻，他自幼就作战士。」

text.en: “He is not wrong about the years.” The old man pulls the strap tight. “He is only wrong about what they are for.”
text.zh: 「他说你年轻，这话不假。」老人把皮带拉紧，「他错在以为年轻就没用。」

text.en: “I have been looked at my whole life, son. Take the word that answers it.”
text.zh: 「我这一辈子，都是被人这样看的。」他说，「带上一句能回这话的。」

text.en: “The stones are at the brook, past the tents. Five is what he took. Not six.”
text.zh: 「石子在下游的溪边，过了帐篷就是。他当时捡了五块，不是六块。」

text.en: “Fear not, stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD.”
text.zh: 「不要惧怕，只管站住，看耶和华今天向你们所要施行的救恩。」

text.en: “Thou comest to me with a sword, and with a spear: but I come to thee in the name of the LORD.”
text.zh: 「你来攻击我，是靠着刀枪和铜戟；我来攻击你，是靠着万军之耶和华的名。」

text.en: “Man looketh on the outward appearance, but the LORD looketh on the heart.”
text.zh: 「耶和华不像人看人：人是看外貌，耶和华是看内心。」

text.en: “The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.”
text.zh: 「耶和华是我的牧者，我必不致缺乏。」

line.en: “Choose you a man, and let him come down to me!”
line.zh: 「你们拣选一个人，叫他下来到我这里来！」

tell.en: He is shouting for the whole valley to hear. He wants you to count the distance.
tell.zh: 他喊得整条山谷都听见。他要你先数一数自己离他有多远。

line.en: “Am I a dog, that thou comest to me with staves?”
line.zh: 「你拿杖到我这里来，我岂是狗吗？」

tell.en: He is looking at your hands, and finding them empty.
tell.zh: 他在看你的手，看你手里到底有没有东西。

line.en: “Whose son is this youth? He is but a boy.”
line.zh: 「这少年人是谁的儿子？他不过是个孩子。」

tell.en: He has stopped talking to you and started talking about you.
tell.zh: 他不再对你说话，开始对别人说你。

line.en: “Forty days, and thy God has sent no one. Will he save thee?”
line.zh: 「四十天了，你的神没有派一个人来。他真会救你吗？」

tell.en: This one is quiet. It is the one that has been working all along.
tell.zh: 这一句很轻。它已经在你心里响了四十天。

triggers.note: crossing north of this row with five stones begins the BECOME

text.en: You reach the line, and your hand closes on an empty pouch. Five stones. The brook is behind you.
text.zh: 你走到界线前，手在袋子里摸了个空。要五块石子。溪水在你身后。

text.en: The brook runs low and slow where the reeds are. Smooth stones lie in it, and they will wait for you.
text.zh: 溪水在芦苇那边又低又缓。光滑的石子就躺在水里，它们会等你。

text.en: The line in the dust is still there, and your hand still knows the weight of five stones. You do not have to fight him again. You only have to remember that you stood here.
text.zh: 土里的那条界线还在，你的手还记得五块石子的重量。你不必再和他打一次。你只需要记得，你曾站在这里。

text.en: 1 Samuel 17:47 — “And all this assembly shall know that the LORD saveth not with sword and spear: for the battle is the LORD’s, and he will give you into our hands.”
text.zh: 撒母耳记上 17:47 ——「又使这众人知道耶和华使人得胜，不是用刀用枪，因为争战的胜败全在乎耶和华。他必将你们交在我们手里。」

text.en: The Valley of Elah. Two armies on two hills, and a brook running between them. You are walking it as a shepherd boy named David, but the hands are yours.
text.zh: 以拉谷。两支军队各扎在一座山上，四十天来谁也没有下山，中间只有一条溪。你以牧童大卫的身份走这一趟——可这双手是你自己的。

text.en: Left thumb moves you. Right side: A talks to whoever you face, » confirms. On a keyboard, arrows or WASD, Z to talk, X to step back.
text.zh: 左手拇指推着走。右下两个键：A 和面前的人说话，» 按住疾走。用键盘就是方向键或 WASD，Z 说话，按住 Shift 疾走。

text.en: Four people are waiting on this road. Listen to each of them, pick up what the brook is holding, and then walk north past the line in the dust.
text.zh: 这条路上有四个人在等你。把他们的话都听完，把溪水里的东西捡起来，再往北走过尘土里的那条界线。
